# Production (non-test) source files that expand `env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")`,
# with the number of uses in each. Frozen by decision 0090, amendment 2.
#
# Each such expansion bakes the ABSOLUTE BUILD PATH into the shipped binary at
# compile time, which is why two builds of one commit in different directories
# do not hash the same. That in turn is what makes binary identity usable as a
# cross-host oracle only when both hosts build at the same absolute path.
#
# This list may SHRINK freely — removing a use makes the binary more portable.
# It may not GROW without a deliberate decision: every addition widens the set
# of paths a build embeds, and none of it is visible in any output.
#
# Format: <workspace-relative path> <count>
cli/src/main.rs 1
windows/lab/src/blackbox.rs 1
